name: shareready-public
description: Check a live webpage's social preview, redirects, and sampled internal links before sharing.

interface.longDescription: ShareReady checks a public webpage before you post it. It reads the live page's title, description, social image, canonical URL, redirects, HTTP status, and a small sample of internal links. Ask what a link will look like when shared or for concrete fixes before launch. ShareReady does not edit your site. Results are point-in-time observations; social platforms may use cached previews.
defaultPrompt: Check if this link is ready to share: https://example.com
What preview will this URL show on social apps?
Find broken links on this page before launch.

positive.description: Audit a public page before posting
positive.prompt: Check whether https://example.com is ready to share.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the tool and report the live status, page title, missing share metadata, and practical fixes.

positive.prompt: What title, description, and image will appear if I share https://example.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Call the tool and distinguish observed metadata from platform-specific cached previews.

positive.prompt: Does http://example.com redirect before people reach it? Check the share link.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the tool and report the final URL and any observed redirects.

positive.description: Check a page without sampling internal links
positive.prompt: Audit https://example.com for sharing, but skip checking its internal links.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the tool with link_limit 0 and summarize metadata findings.

positive.description: Check a page and sample internal links
positive.prompt: Check https://example.com before launch and sample up to 12 internal links.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the tool with link_limit 12 and report how many links were checked and any failures.

negative.prompt: Is my new webpage ready to share?
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the public URL before calling the tool.

negative.prompt: Check http://127.0.0.1:3000/admin before I share it.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not audit a private address; explain that ShareReady accepts public HTTP or HTTPS pages only.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Seattle?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call ShareReady because the request is unrelated to checking a webpage.

publication.release_notes: Adds anonymous daily counts for web visits, MCP connection requests, and completed checks, with a private owner report and updated privacy disclosure. No user IDs or submitted URLs are stored in the metrics database.
